route.ro_lo36: RO: high school + 36 months as qualified LO
route.ro_other_plant: RO: 24 months RO/SRO at another plant + 12 at Barakah
route.ro_fossil: RO: 24 months fossil or other plant + 12 at Barakah
route.sro_ro24: SRO: 24 months as RO at Barakah
route.sro_bsc: SRO: BSc + 24 months at Barakah incl. 12 as LO
route.sro_other_plant: SRO: 24 months RO/SRO/SRO-QI elsewhere + 12 at Barakah

ro_eligibility.name: RO eligibility
ro_eligibility.req: High school + 36 months as fully qualified LO; or 24 months RO/SRO at another plant + 12 months at Barakah incl. 6 on crew; or 24 months at a fossil or different-type plant + 12 at Barakah incl. 9 on crew; plus security clearance.
ro_eligibility.tracker: Shows which route a candidate is on and which evidence is still open. Clearance shows as confirmed or pending only.

sro_eligibility.name: SRO eligibility
sro_eligibility.req: 24 months as RO at Barakah; or a BSc in engineering or a related science + 24 months nuclear work at Barakah incl. 12 as LO; or 24 months RO/SRO/SRO-QI elsewhere + 12 at Barakah incl. 6 on crew; plus clearance.

exams.name: Exams
exams.req: Written exams (generic fundamentals and plant-specific) and operating tests (full-scope simulator and in-plant JPMs). FANR is notified {notice} days ahead.
exams.tracker: Milestone timeline; a reminder {reminder} days before the exam date to send the {notice}-day notice.

validity.name: Validity
validity.req: The certificate is valid {years} years, renewable, for the named facility only.
validity.tracker: Countdown, with renewal tasks from {months} months out.

medical.name: Medical
medical.req: Within 6 months of certification, then every {months} months; fitness for duty per REG-08.
medical.tracker: Due date and a fit / not-yet-confirmed flag only. No medical content is stored.

proficiency.name: Proficiency
proficiency.req: Each calendar quarter, at least {s8} eight-hour or {s12} twelve-hour shifts; an SRO works at least {sro} of them in the SRO role.
proficiency.tracker: Quarter counter from the shift roster feed; a warning when the remaining scheduled shifts cannot meet the minimum.

lapse.name: Lapse reporting
lapse.req: A validity lapse is reported within {days} working days.
lapse.tracker: A task for the licensing coordinator the moment a lapse is detected, with a working-day clock.

withdrawal.name: Withdrawal
withdrawal.req: FANR withdraws the certificate after {years} consecutive years of non-validity.
withdrawal.tracker: Escalating notices from the first lapse.

programme.name: Programme reporting
programme.req: Candidate lists {days} days before programme start; a comprehensive training plan report every {months} months.
programme.tracker: Calendar entries and draft data packs for the coordinator to review.

requal.name: Requalification
requal.req: FANR biennial requalification exam; refresher training verified every 2 years.
requal.tracker: Window and readiness view, linked to COCT attendance.

pub.intro: How Reactor Operator and Senior Reactor Operator certification works at Barakah, the entry routes, and what a certificate requires once held.
pub.notAuthorityTitle: Kafa'a is a tracker, not an authority
pub.notAuthorityBody: FANR certifies operators. ENEC Operations prepares, proctors and grades the exams. FANR records its decisions in its Operator Certification Tracking System. Kafa'a mirrors status and raises reminders; it never decides or sends anything to FANR.
pub.whoFanrBody: The Federal Authority for Nuclear Regulation issues, renews and withdraws RO and SRO certificates, reviews exams and records decisions.
pub.whoEnecBody: The licensee runs the SAT-based programmes, prepares, proctors and grades the exams, and reports to FANR.
pub.whoKafaaBody: Mirrors certificate status, medical due dates and shift counts, and reminds people of deadlines. Notices are drafts for a named role to send.
pub.s1Body: High-school diploma; DNT (24 months) or LOIT (60 weeks / 1,920 h). Licensee qualification, not FANR certification.
pub.s2Body: Classroom, on-the-job training with qualification cards, and main-control-room simulator training (91 weeks / 2,912 h per the 2024 sustainability report).
pub.s3Body: Written, JPMs and simulator, prepared and graded by the licensee.
pub.s4Body: The licensee notifies FANR of the exam 60 days before it is held.
pub.s5Body: Generic fundamentals and plant-specific written exams; simulator scenarios and in-plant JPMs.
pub.s6Body: Facility-specific; kept valid by annual medicals, quarterly shift minimums, COCT and biennial requalification.
pub.routesDesc: Three routes to each certificate. Each route also needs a UAE security clearance.
pub.clearance: Plus a UAE security clearance on every route (Kafa'a records only confirmed or pending).
pub.rulesTitle: What the regulation requires and how Kafa'a tracks it
pub.rulesDesc: Rules held as data; numbers come from the same constants the tracker and the database use.
pub.statCerts: RO and SRO certifications at Barakah
pub.statCertsSub: Over 300 certifications by early 2025, 140 of them to UAE nationals (certifications may include renewals).

cert.title: Certificate
cert.renewalNote: Within {n} months of expiry: renewal tasks are open with the licensing coordinator.

med.title: Medical
med.noContent: Within 6 months of certification, then every {n} months. Kafa'a holds the due date and a flag only; no medical content is stored.
med.noContentShort: Due date and flag only. No medical content.
med.overdueBody: The due date has passed and no new date is recorded. The licensing coordinator has a task to confirm a new date.

prof.title: Shift proficiency
prof.quarterDesc: Counts from the shift roster feed; the quarter ends {end}.
prof.noData: No shift counts received for this quarter
prof.onTrackMsg: On track: the scheduled shifts can still meet the minimum.
prof.rule: REG-17 Art. 11: at least 7 eight-hour or 5 twelve-hour shifts per quarter; an SRO works at least 2 of them in the SRO role.

requal.title: Requalification
requal.desc: Biennial requalification readiness: COCT attendance against the hours required, and the FANR requalification exam status (mirrored).

my.intro: Your certificate as recorded in the licensee's certification records, your medical due date, this quarter's shifts and your requalification window.
my.noneBody: This page shows a Reactor Operator or Senior Reactor Operator certificate once the licensee's records hold one for you.
my.staleTitle: Not confirmed: the source sync is stale
my.staleBody: The last sync was {h} hours ago (limit {max}). Until a fresh sync arrives Kafa'a does not show your certificate as valid.
my.lapsedBody: Validity lapsed on {date}. The licensing coordinator reports it within 3 working days. FANR withdraws the certificate on {wd} if validity is not restored.
my.openItemsDesc: Tasks and milestones that concern you. The licensing coordinator owns them.
my.footer: Kafa'a mirrors records and raises reminders. It never decides certification and never sends anything to FANR.

val.intro: Everyone certified, sorted by the soonest risk. Status lines read "as recorded in [system] on [date]"; a stale sync never shows as valid.
val.sweepConsequence: Kafa'a records lapses for certificates past their expiry date (each with a 3-working-day reporting task), opens medical-overdue tasks, renewal tasks from 12 months out, proficiency-risk tasks, 75-day exam-notice reminders and withdrawal escalations.
val.staleNote: The sync is older than 72 hours, so this certificate is not shown as valid.
val.mirrorStatus: Mirror a status from the source record
val.mirrorStatusBody: Use this only to mirror what the licensee's certification record says. A lapse opens a reporting task with a 3-working-day clock.
val.statusConsequence: The mirrored status becomes {status}. Give the source record reference.

tasks.calloutBody: Deadlines count UAE working days (Monday to Friday). A lapse detected on a Thursday is due the following Tuesday. Kafa'a sends nothing to FANR: close a task once the named role has sent the notice through official channels.
tasks.title: Task
tasks.closeConsequence: The task closes. Record what was done and by which role.
tasks.medicalConsequence: Mirror the new due date and fitness flag from the occupational health record. Open medical tasks for this person close.

cand.intro: Candidate lists for each licensing programme, with each candidate's REG-17 Art. 4 route and the evidence still open.
cand.calloutBody: Candidate lists are due 60 days before a programme starts. Kafa'a prepares a draft for the licensing coordinator to review and send through official channels. Clearance shows as confirmed or pending only.
cand.none: No candidates on this programme yet
cand.cycle: Select to change: verified, open, pending
cand.openWarning: Some evidence is still open. Eligibility is determined by ENEC and FANR; make sure the evidence supports this.
cand.footnote: Select an evidence item to change its status. No clearance details are held: only confirmed or pending.
cand.addNote: Evidence starts as open and clearance as pending. Update them as the records arrive.

cal.intro: Reporting obligations and exam milestones in one calendar.
cal.calloutBody: Every obligation is a draft for a named role to review and send through official channels. Mark it as sent once the owner has sent it.
cal.addPlanBody: Adds the next comprehensive training plan report, due {d} (6 months after the last one).
cal.move_sent_by_owner: Mark as sent by the owner
cal.moveBody_drafted: "{title}" is drafted and ready for the named role to review.
cal.moveBody_sent_by_owner: Confirm that the named role sent "{title}" through official channels. Kafa'a itself sends nothing.
cal.tooLate: The 60-day notice date ({d}) has already passed. Check the exam date with the training team.
cal.autoNotice: Kafa'a will add the 60-day FANR notice on {notice} (reminder {reminder}) and a draft exam-notice obligation.
